subject.name: Word processors and typists
subject.summary: Word processors and typists correspond to O*NET43-9022.00, using word processing equipment or computers to form letters, reports, and tables from drafts, revisions, recordings, or earlier versions, checking spelling, punctuation, and format, adjusting layout, saving, retrieving, and passing on files, and possibly taking on other clerical tasks. The focus is faithful correspondence to the source and version, not original writing, all office affairs, or all data entry. Word and Office requirements are not generative AI adoption. The paper revision problem uses a fictional notice only and does not handle real personnel or files, send anything, or approve on behalf of the business.
